actions.identifyUser.description: Create or update user information and traits in LogRocket to contextualize user behavior.
actions.identifyUser.props.appId.descrip: Your LogRocket app/project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)
actions.identifyUser.props.orgId.descrip: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)
actions.identifyUser.props.timestamp.des: Unix timestamp in milliseconds indicating when this data was collected (optional)
actions.identifyUser.props.traits.descri: User traits as key-value pairs (e.g., {"plan": "free", "age": 43}). Values will be converted to strings.
actions.identifyUser.props.userId.descri: The unique identifier for the user
actions.requestHighlights.description: Request session highlights for a user. Results will be sent to the webhook URL when ready.
actions.requestHighlights.props.orgId.de: Your LogRocket organization ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID before the slash)
actions.requestHighlights.props.projectI: Your LogRocket project ID (found in Settings > General Settings, or in your App ID after the slash)
actions.requestHighlights.props.timeRang: End of the time range for sessions (optional)
Start of the time range for sessions (optional)
actions.requestHighlights.props.userEmai: The email of the user to get highlights for
actions.requestHighlights.props.userId.d: The ID of the user from LogRocket.identify() calls
actions.requestHighlights.props.webhookU: URL where highlights results will be posted when ready. You can get this from the "Highlights Ready" trigger.
auth.description:
To get your LogRocket API key:

1. **Login to your LogRocket Dashboard**
2. **Go to Settings > General Settings**
3. **Copy your API key** from the API Key section
4. **Paste it here**

Your API key is used to authenticate requests to the LogRocket API.
description: Get AI-generated summaries of user sessions to understand customer behavior and troubleshoot issues faster.
triggers.highlightsReady.description: Trigger when session highlights are ready. Use this webhook URL when requesting highlights.
## Webhook Configuration

This trigger receives highlights results from LogRocket when they're ready.

**To use this trigger:**

1. Copy the webhook URL below
2. Use it as the **Webhook URL** field when using the "Request Highlights" action
3. When highlights are ready, this trigger will fire with the results

**Webhook URL:**
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
